results.title: Invalid API authentication
results.root_cause: GET /secure-data rejected the request with HTTP 401: the API key / token was missing, malformed, expired or lacks the required scope.
results.recommended_actions: Verify the X-API-Key header value against the key store | Check key expiry & rotation schedule; re-issue and redeploy the credential | Confirm the monitoring job's secret store is in sync after rotation | Add a pre-flight credential check to the synthetic monitor

results.title: API timeout
results.root_cause: GET /simulate-timeout exceeded the 3000 ms timeout budget (observed 8009 ms) and the connection was aborted.
results.recommended_actions: Check database slow-query log and add the missing index / query cache | Move blocking work to a background task or add an async client | Add or tighten upstream timeouts + circuit breaker so callers fail fast | Scale the service horizontally or raise the worker/connection pool size

results.title: Server error (HTTP 500)
results.root_cause: Unhandled RuntimeError raised while serving GET /simulate-error: Simulated upstream failure: inventory service returned no data
results.recommended_actions: Inspect captured stack trace for request_id=lab-471c7a08af34 (Dashboard -> Incidents -> Evidence) | Reproduce with the same payload in staging and add a regression test | Add explicit exception handling + structured logging around the failing call | Roll back the last release if the error started immediately after a deploy

results.title: Rate limit exceeded (HTTP 429)
results.root_cause: GET /simulate-rate-limit returned HTTP 429: the caller exceeded the configured request quota for the current window.
results.recommended_actions: Honour the Retry-After header and apply exponential backoff with jitter | Reduce synthetic probe frequency or raise the endpoint quota | Introduce per-consumer quotas so one client cannot starve the others

results.title: Latency SLO breach (> 3s)
results.root_cause: GET /simulate-timeout responded in 3504 ms which is above the 3000 ms latency SLO.
results.recommended_actions: Profile the handler and optimise the dominant query / serialisation cost | Add response caching or pagination for large payloads | Review autoscaling policy and recent traffic growth

results.title: Service health check failure
results.root_cause: GET /health returned HTTP 503 - the service reported itself unhealthy because a readiness dependency failed its probe.
results.recommended_actions: Inspect the /health dependency breakdown and the failing component's metrics | Check database connectivity and connection-pool saturation | Fail over to the replica or restart the degraded dependency

results.title: API downtime (connection refused)
results.root_cause: GET http://127.0.0.1:9/health is unreachable - connection refused: All connection attempts failed. The service process is not accepting connections.
results.recommended_actions: Check process liveness, restart count and container logs | Verify the listening port and ingress/route configuration | Restart the service and confirm /health returns 200 | Review recent deployments and infrastructure events
